purpose: Select one economically distinct historical-only minute mechanism after Campaign053 using definitions only and no Campaign054 value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_inventory.composition: The 76 definitions reconstructed by the frozen Campaign053 protocol in exact order, followed by terminal Campaign053.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures signed asymmetry of the full-session executed-price distribution using share-volume-weighted quartiles. No frozen factor measures robust skew of transaction-price levels across volume mass.
That sign-neutral central-tendency disagreement is the terminal intraday_transaction_vwap_consensus_240m mechanism.
Time-ordered price changes would reopen the terminal return-skewness and transaction-price-path families; Campaign054 stays on unordered price-level volume quantiles.
Clock-window price location would restate late VWAP, terminal close location, amount timing, or morning/afternoon profile mechanisms.
That is the Campaign053 amount/price-update discovery family which is terminal and cannot be rescued or reformulated.
Campaign054 freezes quartiles 0.25/0.50/0.75, share-volume weights, higher direction, the full 240-bar support, and no alternative transform, threshold, filter, subset, combination, fit, or model.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_volume_weighted_transaction_price_bowley_skew_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A right-skewed distribution of executed transaction-price levels across share-volume mass indicates that meaningful trading reached a longer upper-price tail than lower-price tail, consistent with asymmetric willingness to execute at elevated prices that may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: On the exact 240-bar continuous grid, retain active bars with volume>0 and amount>0 after enforcing joint-zero inactivity and rejecting any one-sided zero. Let x_i=log(amount_i/volume_i) and w_i=volume_i. For tau in {0.25,0.50,0.75}, Q_tau is the smallest sorted x whose cumulative weight at prices <=x is at least tau*sum(w). Return (Q_0.75+Q_0.25-2*Q_0.50)/(Q_0.75-Q_0.25).
selected_candidate.active_bar_rule: volume>0 and amount>0; a joint-zero bar is inactive; any one-sided zero invalidates the stock-day
selected_candidate.transaction_price: amount/volume; the provider-unit constant cancels inside log-price quantile differences
selected_candidate.quantile_estimator: left-continuous inverse of the share-volume-weighted empirical CDF: smallest sorted log transaction price whose inclusive cumulative weight reaches tau times total active weight
selected_candidate.tie_semantics: Aggregate weight implicitly at equal transaction prices through the inclusive empirical CDF; never break a price tie by clock order
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Require every raw volume and amount finite and nonnegative, every active transaction price finite and positive, at least 120 active bars, positive total active volume, and Q_0.75>Q_0.25

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value overlap audit against the 77 inherited definitions, then freeze the exact 77-comparison no-return protocol before implementation or any value read.
